claims.quote: Known only from parts of the Xi Jiang (West River) watershed, the major affluent of the extensive Zhu Jiang (Pearl River), in Guangxi Autonomous Region and Guangdong Province, southern China.
The habitat of this loach, described by Fang in 1930, is the Nanpan-jiang and Xi-jiang basins in Guangdong to Guangxi provinces in China.
